surface_verification.justification: triage CLI/library route-reporting change; no startable web/dev-server surface of its own to browser-verify — verification is the subprocess CLI round-trip tests plus the full shared/ unit suite (F0).

behaviors.behavior: mark_status(return_item=True) reports outbox route on idle main
mark_status(return_item=True) reports tracked route on a non-default branch
the new to_outbox element is appended at index 2, previous/item keep indices 0/1 (backward-compat regression guard)
dismiss/snooze --json emit route=tracked on a non-default branch
dismiss/snooze --json emit route=outbox on idle main
amend --json emits route for both outbox and tracked cases
show --json carries no route key (a read, not a write, has nothing to derive)
snooze/amend human (non-json) mode prints the outbox note on idle main
snooze/amend human mode prints the converse tracked-branch note off the default branch
no note at all when tracked AND on the default branch (no origin remote) — the negative case a spec-reviewer flagged as missing
dismiss (non-json)/defer/unpark/promote print the route note (outbox and tracked-branch cases) via the shared _status_flip/cmd_promote dispatch
dismiss/defer/unpark/promote --json emit the route key via the shared dispatch
extending route reporting into triage_promote.py does not silently break pre-existing promote/dismiss/defer exact-dict-equality assertions
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_triage_promote.py::test_promote_happy_path, test_dismiss_happy_path + shared/tests/test_triage_defer.py::test_defer_records_the_decision_and_its_reason, test_dismiss_is_unchanged_by_the_shared_extraction — all updated to assert the additive route key, 66/66 passing
